articleTitle: Analysis of physical activity in China Based on Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: By using the method of linear regression. Based on the data from CGSS in 2015, this article discusses the differences in the harms and systems of subjective class recognition and the influence of social and economic development on sports activities. The results show that:(1) Class identification and SES status have an impact on physical activity. Among them, there is a social division phenomenon in physical activity. (2) The influence of SES status on physical activity is greater than the influence of class identity. All this shows that people in higher strata positions will use their own advantages to consolidate their social status. It shows that subjective class recognition cannot surpass the social development of participating in sports activities. Therefore, this discussion believes that the key point of improving the amount of group exercise may be to complete the fairness and justice of sports culture. Actually, we must do the following aspects: (1) Increase the attention and frequency of social development and exercise, vigorously promote social productivity, and respond to the “right theory”; Small “structuralism”;(3) To truly achieve equality, it is necessary to strengthen the core concept of public cultural services of the local government and improve the socialist social laws and regulations to reduce the “harmfulness of subject and object theory to sports activities.”

articleTitle: Research on Design Preferences of Furniture for the Elderly in the Home Care Model Based on Q Methodology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: The “aging of the population” is an inevitable topic in the development of modern society. As early as 1870, France, where the economy took off after the industrial revolution, had a population over 60 accounting for 12% of the total population, becoming the world's first elderly type nation. Since then, more than 50 countries including China, Sweden, Belgium, Germany, the United Kingdom, the United States, and Japan have also entered an aging society, and the issue of elderly care has also attracted much attention. In our country, most of them are only children, which can satisfy the care of life while maintaining a unique and relatively independent space. However, in the era of high housing prices, this model has certain requirements for the economic status of the family<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. At present, most of the elderly living in our country choose welfare facilities such as traditional nursing homes, and most of them still choose home for the elderly. In the home life, furniture is closely related to the life of the elderly. Therefore, this research aims to investigate and analyze the preference of relevant personnel for the design of furniture suitable for the elderly under the home care model. According to the survey of the elderly, the Q method is used to classify and analyze 33 Q samples, and finally it is concluded that "design focusing on the life behavior, physiological and psychological characteristics of the elderly" is the most biased design element of the designer.

articleTitle: The Association of Income and Depression Status Among Chinese Middle-aged and Older People: A National Representative Longitudinal Study
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In recent years, “mental health” has appeared more on social media than before, and people have paid some attention to it intentionally or unconsciously. For the young generations, schooling education lets them learn more about mental health, and parents take care of their children’s physical health while having more awareness of their mental health. However, middle-aged or even older people’s mental health might not be in the spotlight. There are many pieces of news about some teenagers’ extreme behaviors due to their mental disorders or illnesses, and the tendency for suffering from mental problems, such as depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and others are getting younger, causing more voices advocating to pay attention to mental health, especially to the younger generations. Moreover, the pressure on middle-aged and above-aged people’s mental health, like their depression circumstances, is seldom mentioned and analyzed further. Therefore, the investigation in this paper aims to research the relationship between one of the economic factors and the most important one for those groups of people --- their income --- through using the data from China Health and Retirement Longnitustial Study (CHARLS) in statistical methods, like regression analysis. As a result of the investigation in this paper, the association of those two variables --- people’s income and their depression status --- among Chinese middle-aged and older people is very weak to a degree.

articleTitle: Opportunities and Challenges of Smart Sports Development in China under the Background of 5G
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: 5G communication technology has risen to the strategic height of national development. Under the background of 5G, smart sports is the direction of sports information development. This paper uses the method of literature and semi-structured expert interview to analyze the research status and existing problems of smart sports in China. This paper puts forward some new opportunities for China ‘s smart sports consumption market in the 5G era, such as increasing volume, transforming and upgrading smart venues, leading the new direction of smart sports, and helping social services. At the same time, we should also face the challenges of the demand for sports science and technology talents, the construction of smart sports theory system and the humanistic society of smart sports. It is suggested that the scientific research methods of other related disciplines should be used to enrich the theoretical research of smart sports.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the agglomeration effect of sports industry on Chinese economy
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Under the background of economic new normal, sports industry has increasingly highlighted its pillar function to the economy. Further study of the relationship between sports industry agglomeration and economic growth can not only promote the high-quality development of sports industry, but also play a driving role of sports industry to economy. Based on this, this paper uses data from 2003 to 2019 to quantitatively analyze the impact of sports industry agglomeration on economic growth in China. Through empirical analysis, it is found that:(1) The degree of industrial agglomeration is positively correlated with China’s economic growth, and the effect is significant;(2) State-owned assets and foreign direct investment can promote the rapid development of sports facilities to a certain extent, so as to achieve the agglomeration effect of sports industry and further promote China’s economic development;(3) There is a significant non-linear relationship between industrial agglomeration and economic growth, presenting “U” type feature.

articleTitle: Biomechanics and Engineering Applications of Race Walking
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to summarize the application of mechanics and engineering in race walking. The representative literature was summarized in tabular form using the literature method and induction method. The literature draws conclusions about changes in acquisition equipment and filming methods during race walking in terms of kinematics, kinetics, and electromyography. Filming has changed from the beginning of a single low-speed camera (two-dimensional filming) to a single high-speed camera, to a three-dimensional two-camera high-speed camera, and finally to a computer combined with a high-speed camera to process the data directly on site. Research methods have become more scientific and rationalized, from simple of image analysis to standard 3D motion analysis to different models of human inertial parameters.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of sling exercise Training on Swimmer’s Core Strength and Balance Ability Experiment
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Sling training is a new type of physical training method, which can improve the strength of trunk core muscles, improve the balance of the body, maintain stability, control the body posture and control the center of gravity. Swimming is a sport in the water, which is different from land events. In the unstable sports environment of water, it reflects the importance of core strength. In the process of swimming, trunk muscle group, as the core part of the body, undertakes the role of stability, power generation and power transmission. In this study, the students in the swimming special class of the school of competitive sports of Beijing University of physical education were selected as the experimental objects for 8 weeks of suspension training. Through the tests of the core strength related indicators, body balance related indicators and special scores of the subjects who had undergone suspension training and those who had not undergone suspension training, the experimental test data were statistically processed and analyzed by using the statistical software spss19.0, the results show that the test indexes of the experimental group are significantly different. Suspension training is of positive significance to improve the core strength, balance ability and special performance of swimmers.

articleTitle: Construction of Functional Structure Model of University Smart Gymnasium Under the Background of “Internet +”
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of low utilization rate and low service quality of traditional university gymnasiums, this paper adopts the field investigation method and semi-structured interview method to investigate the construction scheme of new smart university gymnasiums from the perspective of advanced technologies such as Internet, cloud computing, big data and 5G communication. It is found that the construction of smart gymnasium in colleges and universities should contain three functional modules, namely, smart building, smart management and smart service, to solve the three core needs of automation of building equipment, digitalization of daily management and intelligent service for teachers and students respectively. Based on this, this paper attempts to build a functional structure model of smart gymnasium in universities based on “Internet+” and other advanced technologies. This model is of great value and significance to effectively improve the utilization rate of university gymnasiums and gymnasiums, reduce the management cost and improve the service quality.

articleTitle: Construction of China’s Sports Tourism Information Data Model Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Now sports tourism is very popular, but there is still a lack of platform for integrating sports tourism information data in the market. Big data technology can solve this problem. This paper uses big data technology to build a sports tourism information data model. Big data technology can help the model collect structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, use Hadoop and PMP engine to initially calculate and process these data, and then reprocess the processed data. Finally, the processed data is provided to the high-level by resource scheduling and service interface. This model can integrate the sports event information released by the official information on the network, recommend it to users, help users understand the information data related to sports tourism, and help the development of sports tourism.

articleTitle: Influence of Run-up speed on Chinese male triple jump performance
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: The aim of this study is to explore the relationship between the run-up speed and the performance. In triple jump, the jumper’s run-up speed of the last 10 meters before the board is considered to be one of the most important determinants. The study subjects were made up of 57 trials. According to the correlation statistical results, the linear regression model of the last 5 meters run-up speed and the official distance is established, then the degree of correlation between the two is found. According to the results of the study, the last 5 meters of run-up speed explained 42.9% of the official distance. The correlation between the level of the triple jump run-up speed and the performance is 0.655. Under different performance levels, the correlation between the triple jump athletes and the result shows a “rising” trend with the increase of the result, and there are some cases of negative correlation between the run-up speed and the result.

articleTitle: Research on the feasibility analysis and implementation path of 5G network integrating into smart sports classes in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: With the development of society, the 5G technology has gained its pace, which can be accessed everywhere in our community. It is supposed to become the essential infrastructure that supports the development of society. Meanwhile, the arrival of the 5G era will incur a revolution in digital education. Then how to realize the combination of 5G network and intelligent physical education classroom so as to improve the quality of teaching is an urgent problem for college PE in the new era. This essay elaborates on the relevant concepts and analyses the feasibility of combining 5G technology and intelligent physical classrooms in university. Based on the analysis, this essay proposed three paths that enable universities to achieve the goal: 1. constructing a diversified platform for online PE courses; 2. Adopting online and offline teaching methods; 3. Creating intelligent physical courses with characteristics of 5G networks in the new era.

articleTitle: Elite male freestyle swimmers hip roll characteristics research
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: With the progress of modern information technology, the application of high-precision sensors and better algorithms in swimming wearable devices affects the process of scientific swimming. The development process of swimming wearable devices is gradual, which reflects the transformation of scientific theories into scientific and technological achievements. Wearable devices will continue to be optimized in terms of volume, weight, measurement accuracy, waterproof performance, and ergonomics, etc. It is the mission of swimming researchers to embrace and create new technologies, the hip rotation Angle of the slower swimmer is larger than that of the slower swimmer. With the progress of modern information technology, the application of high-precision sensors and better algorithms in swimming wearable devices affects the process of scientific swimming. The development process of swimming wearable devices is gradual, which reflects the transformation of scientific theories into scientific and technological achievements. Wearable devices will continue to be optimized in terms of volume, weight, measurement accuracy, waterproof performance, and ergonomics, etc. It is the mission of swimming researchers to embrace and create new technologies.

articleTitle: Application of Smart Wearing Real-time Heart Rate Monitoring in Sports Training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Few empirical research results on real-time monitoring of athletes ‘ heart rate using intelligent wearable devices. In order to solve the problem of real-time acquisition of body load index of professional athletes in the process of training and competition, this paper uses smart wearable devices with comfort and safety and cloud interconnection to monitor real-time heart rate index of high-level table tennis athletes based on Internet + and cloud platform technology, so as to provide real-time data for exploring scientific and reasonable training methods. It is found that the real-time heart rate monitoring of intelligent wearable devices for athletes training is beneficial to the formulation of scientific training plans, the recovery of sports injuries, the improvement of sports training effect, and the prevention of overtraining.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Citespace Based Wearable Sports Equipment Research Progress
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Through the theoretical framework and practice of the research on wearable sports equipment, the evolution of domestic wearable sports equipment in the past nine years and the forefront of hot spots are summarized. In this paper, CNKI was used as the data source, literature research method, scientific measurement method, and knowledge graph software Citespace and SATI were used to draw knowledge graph of authors, institutions, journals and keywords, and to make statistics of frequency, frequency and intermediary centrality. The research literature on wearable sports equipment was divided into three stages in time, and the authors, institutions and journal publications were analyzed. The cluster map was used to reveal the research hotspots, and finally the conclusions were drawn.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Badminton Thinking Construction Based on Generative Adversarial Networks and Unsupervised Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: This paper borrows the framework of “generative model” and proposes an unsupervised learning scheme to construct the badminton thinking experiment. First, the data with similar concepts were analyzed from a large number of badminton training data, and classified them into sets of different concepts, such as: objectives, conditions and actions. Three collection of concepts. A new unsupervised learning thinking badminton teaching experiment is designed. Based on the principle of sports thinking, with the help of the oral recording and measurement model, the thinking teaching and traditional teaching proposed by the author were applied to the special classroom of university badminton respectively, and the teaching experiment was conducted. Using literature method, teaching experiment method, oral report method, selected badminton students of qinghai normal university 20 subjects, the application of thinking badminton teaching research, in order to improve the quality of college badminton teaching, promote the preliminary progress in sports.

articleTitle: Research on the spatial clustering of tuberculosis cases in Wenshan Prefecture, Yunnan Province from 2009 to 2018
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Objective: This research is to describe the current situation of tuberculosis epidemic in Wenshan Prefecture and explore the spatial clustering distribution characteristics of cases..Methods: The number of reported cases of tuberculosis in Wenshan Prefecture from 2009 to 2018 was epidemiological description and spatial autocorrelation analysis.Results: From 2009 to 2018, the number of reported cases of tuberculosis in Wenshan Prefecture was 10,210. The cumulative reported cases were 17,972 males (66.31%), and 9131 females (33.69%). The age distribution of the affected population was 44.58±16.60 years old, mainly concentrated in over 60 years old age group (6653 persons, accounting for 24.55%) and the 19–29 year-old group (5066 persons, accounting for 18.69%); the occupational composition of the cases was mainly farmers (24084 cases, accounting for 88.86%), followed by students (748 cases, (2.76%); Moran’s I index of the reported cases were all greater than 0, indicating that the distribution of tuberculosis cases in the spatial unit was positively correlated, with (Z>1.96)and (P<0.05), and the difference was statistically significant.Conclusion: From 2009 to 2018, the number of reported cases in Wenshan Prefecture of Yunnan Province showed an overall upward trend, and the distribution of cases in spatial units was positively correlated with spatial clustering as a whole; hot spots were mainly concentrated in the middle of Wenshan Prefecture, and cold spots were mainly concentrated in the south . In addition to the implementation of basic public health services, personalized health education methods should also be adopted for border ethnic minority areas, so as to further control the prevalence and spread of tuberculosis in border areas.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of elastic Belt resistance training on the speed of young 400 meters athletes
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: 400 meters athletes need to have a very high level of speed quality, recent years, the elastic band is used in various training projects due to its convenient and scientific training mode, but currently there are relatively few applications for young 400m athletes. Based on the speed training characteristics of the 400 meters race, this article designs an exercise plan in combination with elastic bands, and compares them with research methods such as literature, experiments, and logical analysis. Research shows that elastic band resistance training is effective and interesting to improve the 400 meters special performance, and can improve the enthusiasm of athletes in training.

articleTitle: Metabolism Characteristics of Organic Acids in Urine of Greco-Roman Wrestlers Before Competitions
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Background: weight reduction before competitions is a common phenomenon. Almost 90% of wrestlers have experienced weight reduction and weight control, pre-competition weight loss will have a negative impact on their nutritional status hormonal status and immune function. Precision nutrition management has become an important part of scientific and technological guarantee for sports teams.Methods: based on metabolomics to quantify the nutrient metabolism status of Greco-Roman wrestlers, a full set of organic acid metabolomics testing was performed through iquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) methods.Results: ten athletes have poor response to energy production in cell mitochondria; nine athletes have poor carbohydrate metabolism; nine athletes lack vitamin B complex; eight athletes have abnormal neurotransmitter metabolism; ten athletes have an imbalance of intestinal flora.Conclusions: metabolomics is to scan all metabolites in a panoramic manner, and analyze the body’s metabolic reactions caused by exercise and training as a whole. A full set of organic acid metabolism indicators can more comprehensively and intuitively reflect the athlete’s body metabolic state before the game. Wrestlers are prone to poor organic acid metabolism before competition.

articleTitle: Physical Fitness Test System Based on Visual Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In order to realize the efficiency and fairness of physical fitness test, in this paper, we proposed a complete system based on visual analysis, including action recognition, counting, and evaluation. We presented an approach for the action recognition based on spatial-temporal graph convolutional network of multi-semantic fusion, we introduced the both time and frequency domain information of the key point sequence for the action counting, and the action evaluation was realized by using action sequence similarity score. In sit-ups, push-ups, rope skipping and other projects, the accuracy of action recognition reached 98%, the accuracy of action counts reached 95%, and the recall rate of action evaluation on sit-ups and push-ups reached 88%.

articleTitle: Spatial Variability Optimization Of Volleyball Player’s Position Rotation In Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Under the computer machine vision, when the traditional method is used to study the spatial characteristics of volleyball player’s position rotation, with the increasing uncertainty of volleyball player’s position rotation, the spatial state recognition effect is not good, and the guidance for adjusting tactics is not strong. In this paper, a design method of 3D gesture reconstruction system for volleyball spiking based on stereo vision was proposed. First of all, the 2D gesture image of volleyball spiking was obtained by sensors or cameras, and then a smooth denoising was conducted to the noise. Secondly, based on the calibration principle of 2D plane target, a 3D gesture image geometric model of volleyball spiking was established and its parameters were obtained. Finally, binocular stereo vision algorithm was used to realize the feature extraction and matching of the 3D dimensional gesture image of the volleyball spiking action and complete the 3D gesture reconstruction. By solving the action parameter equation of the visual feature image of the volleyball player’s position rotation, the spatial variability of the position rotation was optimized. The experimental results showed that the algorithm could accurately and effectively analyze and identify the spatial characteristics of the volleyball player’s position rotation under machine vision, and it had an important guiding significance for improving the player coordination and cooperation quality.

articleTitle: Visual analysis of Biomechanical of lower limbs in 2001–2020 based on VOSviewer
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Taking WOS (web of Science) as the retrieval platform, the retrieval time is from 2001 to 2021. 2180 English core journals on lower limbs biomechanics in recent 20 years are visually included by using “vosviewer 1.6.17”. By analyzing the existing research literature, the number of papers, research countries and key words related to lower limb biomechanics are sorted and summarized hope to understand the current research situation and judge the future research trend, so as to provide reference for further research. VOSviewer is a commonly used visual analysis software, but there are few related analyses on lower limb biomechanics. It is found that in the past two decades, the exploration in related fields has been deepening, among which the United States, Britain and Australia are the active countries with more research in this field, and coordination, speed, model are the most popular words, which reflect the current research trend.

articleTitle: Research on American Professional Basketball League based on big data technology
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: As a complete sports business system, American Professional Basketball League has the most advanced professional basketball league data analysis system in the world. Its data application ability and data achievement transformation have changed the basketball data management mode. Now, if professional basketball leagues all over the world want to carry out in-depth commercial operation, they cannot lack the participation of big data analysis technology. Big data analysis technology is of great significance to player mining, tactical play and training monitoring. Nowadays, the American Professional Basketball League can accurately extract the unstructured data in the game and provide the team with detailed in-depth statistical analysis data and tracking report, which also lays the foundation for the commercial profit of the American Professional Basketball League. The sport Vu data analysis system, fine-grained high-order statistical analysis system and visual data information system in the American Professional Basketball League can provide some reference for the development of Chinese professional basketball.

articleTitle: Research on the Model Construction for Health Management Service of Community-based Eldercare in the Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Embedding the concept and application of big data into the community-based eldercare management service system is an important support for the future development of community-based eldercare services. It will completely change the management model while improving the technology content of elderly care services. It is of great epochal significance and practical value to construct the big data service mode of community-based eldercare health management, which mainly includes the collection of health data, the establishment of electronic health records, assessment and classification, health intervention and education, health tracking and effectiveness evaluation, and proposes to improve the operating mechanism of the model. The countermeasures and suggestions in this way will drive and revitalize community-based eldercare health management service resources, provide a reference for solving the real community-based eldercare problems in the era of big data, and assist in solving the increasingly severe aging problem in our country.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Changes in Health Inequality of Chinese Residents: based on data from China Health and Nutrition Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: With the rapid development of China’s economy, the health of residents has been greatly improved. However, the problem of residents’ health inequality has become increasingly prominent. Using CHNS data from the year 1993–2018, this paper measures the health of Chinese residents through the Daily Living Ability Scale (ADL), and then uses generalized metric entropy to estimate the extent of health inequality among Chinese residents. On this basis, this paper measures and compares the degree of health inequality between urban and rural residents, residents of different income levels, and educational levels. The empirical research shows that in the last few years, the health inequality index of Chinese residents changed from 0.106 to 0.165, showing a rising trend in fluctuation. There are significant differences in health inequality among residents of different income levels, educational levels, and geographical distributions. China needs to do more to improve public health.

articleTitle: Research on the optimization of “Physical Fitness and health Management” major in Colleges and universities -- From the perspective of health big data demand
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In order to improve the training effect of sports talents in colleges and universities and effectively enhance the influence of undergraduate talents on health big data, this paper analyzes and studies the establishment of sports fitness and health management major from the perspective of social demand. The problems of this major are analyzed in advance, and the feasibility of setting this major is statistically analyzed. On this basis, the related system of sports fitness and health management is established as reference data in the field of fitness.

articleTitle: Research and Discussion on Chinese Traditional Medicine Health Culture Literacy——Based on Visual Analysis of CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: By analyzing the literature on Chinese medicine health culture literacy in CNKI database from 2009 to 2020, judge the research status and hotspots in this research field, predict the research trend, and provide research basis for improving Chinese residents’ Chinese medicine health culture literacy. Search the literatures in CNKI database from 2009 to 202, 178 literatures were included. After screening, the number of effective literatures was 103. The authors, institutions, keywords and emergent words of the included literatures were analyzed by CiteSpace v5.7.r2 software. The annual number of papers on Chinese medicine health culture literacy in China is increasing; There is less academic cooperation between research institutions in different regions; The core author group is small; At present, the research focus is around the analysis of the current situation and influencing factors of Chinese medicine health culture literacy. The research frontier and trend focus on three aspects: the correlation index of literacy level, the influencing factor index and the research on the needs of Chinese medicine culture. Academic circles pay more and more attention to the research on health culture literacy of traditional Chinese medicine, which provides a scientific research basis for relevant policy-making.

Author Keywords: Chinese Medicine Health and Cultural Literacy

articleTitle: Application of applied computer technology in modern sports field
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, China has also brought about various deep innovations in the computer field. At the same time, there are also many difficult problems in the field of modern sports, so the application of computer technology has a very broad application prospect in the field of modern sports. This paper first explains the importance of modern sports, then expounds the application of computer technology in modern sports, and finally points the application path of computer technology in modern sports. The deep development of computer technology has become a trend, and the general use of information technology means based on computer technology has boosted the process of technology and sports. The research aims to further broaden the development space of modern sports through the analysis and application of computer technology.

articleTitle: An experimental study of “All Involved Sports Meet Program” on physical improvement of students in “Universities Participate in Primary School Education Project “ schools in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Objective: The improvement of students’ physical fitness level has become a hot issue of concern at present. We will explore the positive role of the “All Involved Sports Meet Program” in improving the physical health level of primary and middle school students, so as to accumulate practical experience and theoretical reference for the reform of physical education.Methods: 155 students in grade 4 of an experimental school under the project of “Universities Participate in Primary School Education Project “ in Beijing were selected to carry out the physical education reform intervention of “All Involved Sports Meet Program”. Through monitoring and comparison of students’ physical condition, the promotion effect of “ All Involved Sports Meet Program “ on students’ physical health was analyzed and tested.Results: Before and after physical education reform intervention: (1) Body shape: BMI index did not improve significantly;(2) Physical function: lung capacity of male and female students increased significantly, F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">M</inf>(3,1)=51.46, p<0.01; F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">F</inf>(3,1)=66.01, p<0.01;(3) Physical fitness: the scores of male and female students in 50*8 round-trip running, sitting forward bend, rope skipping, 50 meters and sit-ups have been significantly improved, p<0.01.Conclusion: “All Involved Sports Meet Program” to the student body shape, physical function, endurance, flexibility, strength, coordination, speed multiple physical qualities, have different degrees of promoting tips parent-school cooperative mode and can improve the students’ interest in sports and participation of teaching reform to improve the students’ physical health condition of the whole has a positive role.

Author Keywords: "All Involved Sports Meet Program": primary school students

articleTitle: Research on the Development Trend of Vault in Women’s Competitive Gymnastics : — Based on the Tokyo Olympics Games
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In response to the national fitness plan and with the advent of the digital wave and information age, some new terms such as “health big data” and “smart sports” come into our eyes gradually. It is the general trend to seek more efficient sports development methods. In women’s athletics gymnastics vault, for example, this paper tries to adopt method of literature study, video observation, mathematical statistics and other research methods, to the Tokyo Olympic Games women’s vaulting horse eight before the final technical action, the results of the competition, completion, action type as the research object, analyses the development trend of women’s athletics gymnastics vault, Then it provides reference for exploring the development of other sports projects. The results show that it is still necessary to develop the difficult and innovative vault movement; finish quality is also one of the key factors to win; athletes should have higher athletic ability and coordination ability at all stages; Arab Spring upperstep moves became the trend; landing stability cannot be ignored.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Big Data Technology in Horse Racing Events
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Big data technology is the foundation and symbol of modern society. It has the characteristics of high strategy, high innovation, high penetration, and high investment. The application of big data technology in horse racing events is mainly embodied in three aspects: the event management system, the electronic refereeing and the event communication system, which guarantees the management of horse racing events and plays a huge role in promoting the development of horse racing.

articleTitle: Using Regression analysis to explore Sex Health Cognition of Female College Students in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: It is speculated that people with higher education level will pay more attention to personal health and self-protection. This study using regression analysis to explore the sex health cognition and attitude on STD/HIV prevention of female college students in China. The purpose is to understand whether female college students with high education pay more attention to their own sex health. An online questionnaire is used to collect data from respondents. Questionnaire items were related to knowledge, condom use for safe sex, and prevention of STD/HIV. The sample data shows that more than 80% female college students have studied STD/HIV prevention education programs, and the STD/HIV prevention programs already have a positive impact on female college students to improve their willingness to use condoms and pay attention to learn safe sex. It also finds that female college students do discriminate against HIV infection for both have been participated STD/HIV prevention education or not. Even those who have participated STD/HIV prevention program with correct STD/HIV knowledge are still afraid of HIV infected persons and feel shame to use condoms.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation model of College Students’ mental health
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Based on the two evaluations of College Students’ mental health development, this paper makes a systematic research combined with empirical investigation and statistical data. Data analysis is the basis of mental health evaluation model, and the use of appropriate data processing methods is the key part of mental health evaluation model. According to the general model of mental health evaluation, a scientific mental health data model framework is obtained under the guidance of the system. You can refer to the data table structure in the MOOC learning platform to enrich each data software in the mental health model and build the mental health evaluation data model. At the same time, the data table of learning behavior in the data model can help college students summarize and analyze psychological problems, so as to give corresponding solutions. On the basis of the mental health evaluation model, clustering, social network mining, language analysis and other methods are also used to make the college students’ mental health evaluation model more systematic and intelligent.

articleTitle: Use the special dynamometer for kayak to simulate and analyze the gas metabolism characteristics of high-level kayakers at different stages of the competition
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Purpose: This study uses the kayak dynamometer to simulate the three stages of the start of the oars, the stroke on the way and the final sprint during the competition. Use portable exercise cardiopulmonary function tester to measure HR, V`E, V`O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, V`CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, V`O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Kg, RER and other data during exercise, Analyze the gas metabolism changes and correlations of excellent kayakers during these three stages, in order to intuitively understand the characteristics of kayaking, with a view to realizing special function evaluation and selection of athletes for canoeists, it provides experimental basis and data support for scientific training monitoring.Methods: Using literature method, experiment method and mathematical statistics method to conduct a comprehensive research on the gas metabolism characteristics of simulated canoeists in the three stages of exercise.Research result: There are significant differences in the heart rate of the three stages of exercise patterns (P<0.01). There are statistical differences in the indicators in the three phases of the test. There is a correlation between the gas metabolism indicators in the three-stage test .

articleTitle: A Study on the Phenomenon of Square Dancing Among Residents of Guangzhou, Guangdong : An Empirical Analysis Based on Data Application
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: With the progress of science and technology and economic development, recreational activities have become an important part of human society. With its profound foundation among the public and great vitality, square dancing has rapidly become a popular exercise in the country. In this paper, a study will be conducted on square dancing by using a questionnaire. Through analyzing the questionnaire data with SPSS, this paper explores the development of the market related to square dance and the future prospects of square dancing.

articleTitle: A Medical Dialogue System Based on DIET and Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Medical dialogue systems (MDSs) are quite suitable for automated medical consultation. To construct a state-of-the-art MDS, a prototypal system is designed and verified in this paper. The system is implemented based on the dual intent and entity transformer (DIET) and knowledge graph. The test results show that the system owns good application potential.

articleTitle: Using GIS to analyze the Spatial distribution of marathon events: a case study based on Taiwan area
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: The half marathon approximately 21 kilometers started in the 1980s, and the marathon has shown a diversified development since then. The focus of this research is on the marathon in Taiwan before the COVID-19 pandemic. The selected research method is to integrate the attribute data and spatial data on the GIS platform. Preliminary information on the GIS platform shows that all types of events are held in the western part of the eastern part. The full marathon type shows that the northern metropolitan area and the central metropolitan area are the main event venues in the spatial distribution analysis. Subsequent research data shows that the spatial distribution of the city where the semi marathon is that almost all administrative regions have races. The distribution of half-marathon events is relatively balanced and almost every region has such sport events.

articleTitle: Differences of the Standing Long Jump Results Tested by Two Methods with Pared-samples T Tests
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In accordance with the 2016 <Student Physical Health Standard> of the Ministry of Education, the test content requirements of the standing long jump project were tested and reviewed. And two different methods(namely indoor infrared intelligent instrument testing and outdoor manual measurement testing), in the review, were adopted to analyze the differences in the test results of standing long jump of some students. After sorting the test results through Excel, the statistical software SPSS 26.0 was used to process relevant parameters and the pared-sample T. It is indicated by the conclusion that differences exist in the results of different test methods of standing long jump, which invalidates the data evaluation of students’ health status. Thus, a series of opinions and suggestions are given in this paper.

articleTitle: Telemetry Data Analysis on sEMG Major Muscle Groups in Hanging-up-and-passing-through Horizontal Ladder of 400m Obstacles
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Objective: To study the sEMG (Surface Electromyographic Signal) features of major muscle groups (agonist muscles ) in hanging-up-and-passing-through horizontal ladder of 400m obstacles, and the relationship between these muscles and their movement performance.Methods: The study tests and analyzes the original electromyography, iEMG, and iEMG% of seven male cadets who got an A in the test with standard performance in hanging-up-and-passing-through horizontal ladder of 400m obstacles, by using the method of surface electromyography telemetry and anatomical analysis as well as sEMG synchronal video data collection.Results: The right upper limb and trunk muscle groups generate power in the following order: first, deltoid, biceps brachii, triceps muscle of arm, wrist flexors, wrist extensors and trapezius generate power synchronously, and then triceps muscle of arm, pectoralis major muscles, and latissimus dorsi muscles generate power in sequence. The right lower limb muscles and rectus abdominis generate power in the following: first, hamstrings and pectoralis major muscles generate power synchronously, then gastrocnemius and rectus abdominis muscles in sequence, and quadriceps and tibialis anterior muscles have little power records. iMG and iMG% in descending order: the right upper limb and trunk muscle groups (biceps brachii muscles, wrist flexors, triceps, trapezius, latissimus dorsi muscles, wrist extensors, pectoralis major muscles, trapezius muscles and deltoid muscles); the right lower limb muscle groups and rectus abdominis (hamstrings, pectoralis major muscles, rectus abdominis, gastrocnemius, quadriceps and tibialis anterior muscles).Conclusion: During the training event of hanging-up-and-passing-through horizontal ladder, the power of the upper limbs and muscles related chest and back are essential to drive the body to move on, and the lower limbs, lumbar and abdominal muscles are cooperating to complete the movement by inertance. The muscle power of biceps brachii muscles, brachialis, triceps muscles of arm, flexor, flexor muscle groups, latissimus dorsi muscles, pectoralis minor muscles, and serratus anterior muscles should be greatly developed, and the muscle power of hamstrings, gluteus maximus, iliopsoas muscles, rectus abdominis, internal and external obliques muscles should also be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Application of VR Technology in Physical Education
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: This paper studies the application of VR technology in physical education based on the analysis of the VR technical concepts and the presentation process. The combination scheme of VR technology and physical education can be divided into the following five aspects: the combination of teaching material and VR technology, the combination of theoretical knowledge and VR technology, the combination of motor skill’s movement symbols learning level and VR technology, the combination of motor skill’ s movement logic learning level and VR technology, and the combination of motor skills’ application significance with VR technology. The application process of VR technology in physical education and its effects are analyzed through experiments to provide theoretical guidance for the application of VR technology in physical education.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of sports industry development on the consumption growth of sports nutritional food
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Using the provincial panel data from 2008 to 2019, this paper makes an empirical analysis on the relationship between the growth of sports nutrition food industry consumption and the development of sports industry. The study found that with the expansion of the scale of sports industry, the consumption of sports nutritional food industry showed a significant growth trend. Through further (sys GMM) and (DIF GMM) regression, this paper analyzes the role of various factors on the growth of sports nutrition food consumption, and shows that the scale of sports industry and per capita consumption level of residents significantly promote the growth of sports nutrition food consumption. Then it puts forward the countermeasures and suggestions to continue to promote the development of sports industry and increase the consumption of sports nutritional food.

articleTitle: Empirical Research of sports Assisted EMG Mechanical Bionic Prosthesis
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Purpose: According to the poll on 19 years China Disabled Persons’ Federation, China now has more than 85 million people with disabilities, including body of persons with disabilities proportion for body because of physical reasons for the disabled and the biggest difficult to exercise the problem, the team developed the EMG bionic mechanical prosthesis, in order to test whether EMG bionic manipulator can be normal operation, And to detect the completion of simple sports items after wearing.Research Methods: In this paper, experimental observation and other research methods were used to effectively measure the number of upper limb mutilation in 17 people. Skin myoelectric measurement instruments were used to test the subjects, and the EMG electromyographic signals were tested, recorded and analyzed. And after wearing the EMG biomimetic mechanical prosthesis, the test subjects performed taijiquan, sword-play and simple instrument fitness activities. The experiment was conducted with the completion of movement, manipulator status, stability characteristics, weight bearing, coordination characteristics and self-satisfaction according to the questionnaire survey of the subjects after the test.Results: The EMG bionic hand collected signals from three EMG sensors, and could recognize and make five gestures such as grasping, extending thumb, extending index finger, extending middle finger ring finger and little finger, and palm opening, and the recognition rate could reach more than 99.5%.Conclusions: In this paper, the accuracy of five gestures such as grasping, extending thumb, extending index finger, extending middle finger ring finger and little finger and palm opening after wearing the bionic hand is selected as the test. According to the stability analysis of the experimental results after wearing, it can be seen that the EMG bionic hand can basically participate in some sports projects, and it is stable and feasible. In this paper, the feasibility of independent system and variable step size moving time window method is verified through experiments. The actual online recognition rate of simulation is above 99.5%, and experiments will be continued in the future, which is of great significance to the development of human health.

articleTitle: Data mining investigation of the association between social problem solving and weight loss for obesity control
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Maintaining weight loss is known to enhance the long-term health condition for obese people and require an effective strategy to implement. This paper is aimed at exploring ways for obese people to maintain weight after weight loss by data mining technology, highlighting the association between social problem solving and weight loss outcomes. The research is achieved by using the Social Problem Solving Scale and collecting questionnaires and weight data from 101 team members who have left the online fat loss class for three months, where 27 of them are interviewed online by voice or video. The SPSS 26.0 is applied to test the predictive effect of social problem solving on weight loss. The results reveal that the weight loss effects after three months is significantly associated with negative problem tendency (γ=−0.23, P<0.05). According to regression analysis, negative problem solving tendency can accurately predict weight for the people losing weight, which is successfully validated by statistical significance with effect value. Our research concludes that an improvement on individual’s social problem solving skills can lead to a remarkable transformation from negative and other irrational problem solving to positive and rational problem solving. This can increasingly facilitate health benefits, such as an effective control on weight and a significant decrease on the potential for various diseases, subsequently offering the sense of well-being and life satisfaction for individuals.

articleTitle: Construction of an Evaluation Index System for the Enforcement effects of Campus Football Teacher Training in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: This paper analyzed the status of campus football teaching teams in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the skills and professional qualities of the teachers, the influence of football matches, and the current status of the evaluation system. The statistical software, SPSS, was used to process the data. The mathematical statistics methods including descriptive statistics, t test and regression analysis were utilized to obtain the research results. The research finds that: the number of teachers who specialize in football is small in the schools of the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and the football teachers are heavily lacked; to effectively deal with the shortage of faculty, setting up reasonable and targeted training courses is of importance; and football teachers’ years of leading a football team and the condition of teachers who specialize in football are the key factors influencing the performance of football teams. Suggestions: The Ministry of Education in China should create green channels of jobs, increase the proportion of football specialized teachers in the schools of Guangdong Province, select teachers for training according to strict criteria, and build up a training effect evaluation system and high-quality assessment system.

articleTitle: Research on Comprehensive Intervention of Aerobics on Mobile Phone Addiction of Female College Students
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: The effect of comprehensive intervention program was explored, focusing on aerobics on mobile phone addiction among female college students. 60 female college students were randomly selected in this program, who expressed willingness to participate in the experiment with mobile phone addiction. Quasi-experimental design is applied, randomly dividing the subjects into a control group and an experimental group. In this case, a 4-month comprehensive intervention combining all-in-one exercise intervention inside and outside aerobics class and psychological guidance was carried out. The results of the experiments showed that the total scores of mobile phone addiction, scores of various factors, anxiety and depression scores of female college students in the control group increased significantly with time (2 months, 4 months), among which there were significant differences in the total scores of mobile phone addiction, scores of feeling anxious and lost subscale, scores of anxiety and depression at 4 months. After 2 months of comprehensive intervention, compared with before the experiment, the total scores of mobile phone addiction, the scores of various factors, the total scores of anxiety and the total scores of depression in experimental group all showed a downward trend, with significant differences (P<0.05); After the intervention for 4 months, the total scores of mobile phone addiction, the scores of various factors, the total scores of anxiety and the total scores of depression in experimental group had very significant differences (P<0.01). In conclusion, 4-month comprehensive intervention combining all-in-one exercise intervention inside and outside aerobics class and psychological guidance can significantly reduce the mobile phone addiction and anxiety depression of female college students.

articleTitle: Research on the Coordinated Development Mechanism of Sports Industry in Underdeveloped Areas with “Integrating into the Bay Area” as the Background : Taking the Development of Sports Industry in Heyuan City as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Coordinated development is one of the best paths to achieve the development goal of “Integrating into the Bay Area”. Taking the current situation of sports industry development in Heyuan City as an example, it is found that there are still some problems in the development of sports industry in underdeveloped areas, such as lack of awareness of collaborative participation, unreasonable industrial structure layout, imperfect security system, and lack of brand characteristics. In order to solve these problems, the paper puts forward the specific path of building collaborative guidance mechanism, industrial structure optimization mechanism, collaborative guarantee mechanism, brand complementary mechanism and so on.

Author Keywords: the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area

articleTitle: Application of wearable devices in sports: behavior change and result effect
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Taking 1210 documents in the core database of web of science with keywords such as “Sports”, “wearable”, “Sports”, “wearable devices” and “behavior performance” as the data source, this paper uses “cite space” software for visual processing and analysis, combs the application effect of wearable devices in sports in the form of knowledge map, and reveals its research trend Study the cooperative network and the evolution path. Results: 1) in terms of research power distribution, the United States is in the position of “outshining others”, which leads the research direction of the effect of modern wearable devices in sports to a certain extent. In terms of continents, the top two are North America and Europe. The region with a relatively weak research strength is Africa. The research strength in Asia is mainly concentrated in China, South Korea and Japan, while other regions are relatively weak, and the research quality in China needs to be improved. 2) The high-yield authors and teams of sports artificial intelligence research focus on American colleges and universities, with the main research direction of developing and improving intelligent wearable devices for different groups based on machine learning and deep learning technology. 3) Research disciplines, such as medicine, computer science and engineering, are the leading research on the effect of wearable devices in sports. The contribution rate of sports discipline to research on the effect of wearable devices in sports is relatively low, but it is consistent with the characteristics of interdisciplinary integration in this research field. 4) The hot spots of wearable devices in sports research are divided into four clusters, specifically wearable devices and related technologies, wearable device monitoring indicators, wearable device intervention behavior changes, and wearable device intervention effects. Sports form, crowds, wearable technology and methods, research methods, behavior change and result effects are the effective ways to study the intervention effect of wearable devices in sports.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Physical Exercise Affecting Residents’ Self-rated Health : —— Empirical analysis based on CFPS2018 data
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Self-assessment of health status can reflect residents’ quality of life to a certain extent, but its subjective and objective influencing factors are complex. Based on the data of the National Family Tracking Survey (CFPS) in 2018, this paper uses the Ordered Probit Logistic Regression Model to empirically study the influence mechanism of physical exercise on individual self-rated health. The results show that taking part in physical exercise can significantly improve the self-rated health level of individuals, and it has a greater impact on people who meet the standards of physical exercise. Physical exercise can directly affect the self-rated health level, and it can also indirectly affect the self-rated health level with the help of physical and mental health, social capital and income level, and its indirect contribution is 40.45%, 14.88%, 3.06% and 6.55%, respectively. According to the analysis of group differences in gender, urban and rural areas and marriage, Physical exercise has a great influence on the self-rated health of women, urban residents and unmarried residents, and has a great influence on the mediation effect of their mental health. From the difference of educational background, physical exercise has a great influence on the self-rated health of low-educated and high-educated people, but it is the intermediary effect of physiology and income that has a great influence on the self-rated health of low-educated people. Psychological mediation effect has a great influence on highly educated groups. From the perspective of intergenerational differences, physical exercise has a great influence on the income and social effects of the groups before and after the 60s, but it has no significant influence on the income and social effects of the young and middle-aged groups after the 80s and 90s, which may be one of the reasons why the young and middle-aged people frequently die of overwork.

articleTitle: Isokinetic strength training improves motor function in a Chinese classical dancer with knee injury: a case report
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Background: The muscle strength around the knee is essential for maintaining the stability and function of the knee joint of the dancer. If the musculoskeletal system in dancers is imbalanced and weakness this can cause knee injuries. Isokinetic muscle strength training is a special muscle strength training, but scarce studies have explored the effect of the recovery of knee joint function and stability after Chinese classical dancers’ knee injury.Objective: The purpose of this study was to examine whether 10 weeks of isokinetic muscle strength training would improve the functional health status of knee joint injuries in a Chinese classical dancer.Materials and Methods: A male Chinese classical dancer (age, 22 years) diagnosed with chondropathy of the patella, meniscus injury, patellar tendon injury and patellar cartilage injury in the left knee was recruited. The patient underwent a total of 10 weeks of isokinetic strength training of the flexor and extensor muscles on the left leg. Visual analog scale (VAS) score, the peak torque (PT), the total work (TW), the PT ratio of flexors and extensors (hamstring-to-quadriceps strength ratio, H/Q) at the angle of 60°/s, and the Lysholm score were measured before and after 10-week of training.Results: The VAS score decreased from 6.5 to 2.5. The PT of flexors improved from 53.2 to 102.6, which increased by 93%, and the PT of extensors improved from 76.7 to 172.5, which increased by 125%. The TW of flexors improved from 56.6 to 124.9, and extensors improved from 75.8 to 165. The H/Q improved from 69% to 59%. The Lysholm score increased from 47 to 72.Conclusion: Isokinetic strength training of the flexor and extensor muscles on the leg improves motor function and stability of knee joint in the Chinese classical dancer.

articleTitle: Comments on using logistic regression to explore associations between physical activity and happiness
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: As mental health issues become more prevalent, there is growing evidence that physical activity is associated with a lower risk of developing mental illness. Exercise can provide significant psychological benefits throughout a person’s life. These intense and enjoyable opportunities help build self-esteem and perseverance while developing important skills and increasing a person’s happiness. Physical activity strongly connects with mental and physical health, but research on mental health and physical activity is limited. And happiness is an important indicator of mental health. Therefore, the main purpose of this article is to explore the link between physical activity and happiness. We analyzed Eurobarometer 58.2 survey (from categorical to dichotomized) and physical activity data collected by IPAQ-short (i.e. walking, moderate, vigorous) and four domain-specific physical activities (i.e. domestic, leisure, transport, vocation). For examining the association between well-being and physical activity, logistic regression was applied to adjust for gender, age, country, general health status, relationship status, employment, and education. The results show that there is a positive association between physical activity volume and happiness. The odds ratios of highly active, sufficiently active, and insufficiently active are 1.52[1.28–1.80], 1.29[1.11–1.49], and 1.20[1.03–1.39]. Also, there is a small positive association between physical activity intensity and happiness. The odds ratios of walking, moderate-intensity physical activity, and vigorous-intensity physical are 1.02[1.00–1.03], 1.01[0.99–1.03], and 1.03[1.01–1.05]. Moreover, there’s also a positive association between domain specific and happiness. The odds ratios of domestic physical activity, vocational, physical activity and leisure physical activity are 1.42[1.20–1.68], 1.33[1.08–1.64], and 1.05[1.02–1.30], but there are no significant associations for the transport domain. Increasing the physical activity volume can positively affect happiness, and the intensity of physical activity and the physical activity domain also has a relationship with happiness. Thus, mental health can be improved by physical activity.

articleTitle: Regression analysis of general education for equestrian professionals in Colleges and Universities Based on IEO model
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Equestrian major is not only the demand of the times to implement the national sports strategy and the development of sports industry, but also an important part of the general education system of applied universities. Therefore, it is particularly important to scientifically formulate the teaching design suitable for equestrian professionals. Based on IEO model and multiple regression method, this paper takes equestrian major of Wuhan Business University as the research object, and solves the linear programming through multiple linear regression analysis. It analyzes the current situation of equestrian general courses, and puts forward the specific path of combining sports and education to optimize the training of equestrian talents, in order to promote the comprehensive quality of equestrian students, Cultivate a group of high-quality modern equestrian professionals, and comprehensively improve the talent training level of equestrian athletes, coaches and managers of equestrian sports related departments in China.

articleTitle: Research on Lower Limb Motion Characteristics of Oblique Stride on “Euro Step” Layup Based on Intelligent Motion Capture System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In recent years, intelligent motion capture system has been widely used in sports research and training guidance. This study used biomechanical methods, and combined with sports engineering equipment. Surface EMG Tester Delsys, Infrared Spot High-speed Motion Capture Test System Motion and Dynamometer Kistler were utilized to collect the biomechanical data of the first-class basketball players’ “Euro Step” movement synchronously, and quantitative analysis was emphatically carried out on the oblique stride. The research shows that the muscle activation and recruitment degree on one side of the pedal leg in the “Euro Step” layup is stronger than that on the other side; the joint angle of the knee and ankle joints changes greatly. In this action, the plantar exerts force obviously in the horizontal direction. It is suggested that athletes should exercise gastrocnemius muscles in a targeted way to strengthen their pedaling and stretching ability; it is needed for athletes to enhance the strength of the gluteus maximus and biceps femoris and the extensibility of muscles at the hip joint to improve the stability of movement; it is imperative to raise the endurance of tibialis anterior muscle to prevent the corresponding injuries caused by sports fatigue; athletes ought to strengthen strength training of knees and ankles or wear protective gear to prevent joint sprain.

articleTitle: Do the Endurance or the Resistance Exercise Firstly? : —A Meta-analysis on the Sequence Effect of the Intra-session Concurrent Training
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Concurrent strength and endurance training have been applied to improve strength and aerobic performance. However, regardless of the training sequence, strength training followed by endurance training (SE) and reverse training sequence (ES) affects training performance remains controversial. In this study, a meta-analysis method was applied to investigate effects of the training sequence (SE and ES) on the performance in terms of maximum oxygen uptake (VO2max) and maximum strength (MS) in various individuals. A total of 453 subjects were analyzed according to participant age and training forms. Results illustrated that the VO2max for adults (age 19–30 years, mean difference (MD)=1.37, 95% confidence intervals (CI)= (0.15, 2.59), p<0.05 taking SE in the form of water-based exercise improved more significantly [MD=2.04, 95%CI =(0.94, 3.14), p<0.05]than the corresponding group taking ES. MS for adults (age 19–30 years, standardized mean difference (SMD)=−0.61, 95%CI=(−1.13, −0.09), p<0.05 taking ES on land was significantly [SMD=−0.73, 95%CI =(−1.18,−0.28), p<0.05] higher than the corresponding group taking SE. The findings indicate that the sequence of concurrent training affects the training performance of VO2max and MS. It is recommended that subjects should take into account of concurrent training sequence, forms and purposes to optimize training performance.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Children’s Water Safety Education Model in China
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: Objective: To examine the impact of swimming safety education mode on the swimming safety knowledge, swimming safety skills, swimming safety attitudes, and dangerous swimming behaviors of primary school students under the background of “health education”.Methods: A total of 82 second-grade students in elementary school were selected as experimental subjects, and the repeated measures analysis of variance experiment design was used to carry out the research.Results: After the experiment, the swimming safety education model significantly increased the scores of swimming safety knowledge and skills, the difference was statistically significant (t=4.060, 5.325, P<0.05), and the attitude and behavior scores decreased, and the difference was statistically significant (t= −4.392, −2.201, P<0.05); After the experiment, the swimming safety education model is more effective in swimming safety knowledge, attitude and behavior than the traditional swimming teaching, and the difference is statistically significant (t=2.699, 3.852, 4.308, P <0.05); After the experiment, the traditional swimming teaching model compared with the control group, the difference in swimming safety skills was statistically significant (t=4.704, P<0.05), and other dimensions were homogeneous. The traditional swimming teaching can only improve student’s swimming safety skills, but cannot reduce student’s drowning injuries. The swimming safety education model is superior to the traditional swimming teaching in terms of swimming safety knowledge, attitudes and behaviors.

articleTitle: An evaluation study on the prevention of Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) by external factors through Physical activity (PA)-Evidence from a National Survey
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: The morbidity rate of Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) for people aged 65 and above reaches up to 20.8% and it can be seen frequently in the younger-age group in China. The ageing and MCI not only greatly influence the physical and mental health of the aged, but also increasingly aggravate burden to the country and society. This paper aims to explore whether depression is a mediating variable between SES and MCI and whether Physical activity (PA) can mediate the relationship among different variables, provide practical reference for effective prevention, mitigate depression, and reduce the MCI risk. This paper uses the panel data of CLHLS (The Chinese Longitudinal Healthy Longevity Survey) in 2018. Statistical analyses were conducted using SPSS and PROCESS macro. The research results indicate that SES has a significant negatively correlation with MCI of the aged in China. Depression partially mediated the relation between Socioeconomic status (SES) and MCI. Importantly, PA can partially moderate the direct and indirect path between SES and MCI, and showed some differences between different groups. For male group, PA significantly enhanced the inhibitory effect of SES on depression and weakened the promotion effect of depression on MCI, while for the female group, PA only worked by weakening the effect of depression on MCI.

articleTitle: A Study of Online Physical Training for College Students Based on FMS in the Epidemic Situation
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In order to test the effect of online physical training for college students under the epidemic. We selected the college students from Guangzhou X College as the experimental samples, and conducted a study on the distinction between the experimental group and the control group. In the experimental group, the basic physical condition was learned through Functional Movement Screening (FMS). Then carried out cause analysis and functional adjustment exercises for low-scoring items. Based on the weakness of upper limbs and core strength discovered by the experimental group during the test, we conducted targeted online physical training for 8 weeks. A comparative analysis based on the physical test before and after training and the FMS score of the experimental group. After training intervention, it has a significant impact on Shoulder Mobility, Active Straight Leg Raise, Rotary Stability and total score in FMS, but it has a counter-effect on the Hurdle Step, and other test actions have different gender validity. Through the physical test, the data of the experimental group has been significantly improved (P<0.01), but it is still at the passing level, which shows that the physical fitness of the college students is very poor. Although this physical training method is limited to home conditions and training tools, it also effectively improve the physical fitness of college students under epidemic situation. In addition, the results show that the method has a more significant effect on female.

articleTitle: Research on the Basketball Competitive Intelligence System
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Health Big Data and Smart Sports (HBDSS)
abstract: In the new stage of information age, competitive intelligence theory is introduced on the basis of exploring the current situation of competitive intelligence work of high-level basketball teams in China. It also refers to foreign advanced experience in order to establish the theory of basketball competition information system. So that the team basketball competitive intelligence system built with reference to the theory can provide support for the scientific decision-making of decision-makers and help the team gain competitive advantage in the fierce competition. The research shows that the basketball competitive intelligence system is an information operation system established by the team to obtain competitive advantage in the competition, and it is a decision-making assistant system that produces basketball competitive intelligence by collecting and analyzing the information of competitors, our team and competitive environment to assist coaches in decision-making. It consists of collection subsystem, analysis subsystem and service subsystem.
